findings: Complete current MDX SHA-256 is e11b1b6ab3d0bcaaa918ee18c839cac7b6c0b685d1cbdbc5ba516ed11c7c2571; all 4 declared sources passed current HTTPS access review.

Claims remain bounded to displayed permit and wellbore identifiers, query scope, GIS limitations, and PDQ reporting level, lag, update, and revision context. None is converted into a property, development, title, production, payment, or value conclusion.

The article supplies no proprietary, universal, market, or owner-specific numerical assumptions; invents no owner, instrument language, regulatory result, property match, acreage, decimal, production figure, offer, or development result; and makes no owner-specific legal, tax, title, valuation, engineering, financial, or transaction conclusion.

sources_inspected.label: Railroad Commission of Texas, Drilling Permit Query Results Help (accessed 2026-08-23)
sources_inspected.source_location_or_paraphrase: The Railroad Commission drilling-permit results help describes displayed fields including API number, permit status, lease, wellbore profile, filing purpose, amendment indicator, total depth, and links to related detail records.
sources_inspected.claim_scope: The article uses those descriptions only to define fields that may be copied into a neutral comparison matrix; it does not infer property inclusion, development, ownership, production, payment, or value.

sources_inspected.label: Railroad Commission of Texas, Wellbore Query (accessed 2026-08-23)
sources_inspected.source_location_or_paraphrase: The Railroad Commission Wellbore Query exposes search fields for oil or gas, district, lease or gas-well ID, county, field, operator, drilling-permit number, API number, and current or historical scope.
sources_inspected.claim_scope: The article uses those fields only to preserve record identity and query scope; it does not treat a query match as a private-title or economic conclusion.

sources_inspected.label: Railroad Commission of Texas, Public GIS Viewer (accessed 2026-08-23)
sources_inspected.source_location_or_paraphrase: The Railroad Commission describes the Public GIS Viewer as a map view and states that its data is informational, approximate, non-authoritative, and without legal force or effect.
sources_inspected.claim_scope: The article uses GIS only as a locator for a record identifier and expressly rejects map proximity as proof of tract, lease, depth, title, development, production, payment, or value.

sources_inspected.label: Railroad Commission of Texas, Production Data Query System FAQs (accessed 2026-08-23)
sources_inspected.source_location_or_paraphrase: The Railroad Commission explains lease-level oil-production reporting, monthly updates, reporting lag, and later revisions.
sources_inspected.claim_scope: The article uses those limits only to keep reporting level, period, retrieval date, and revision context inside a field comparison; it does not attribute production to a private interest or infer payment or value.
